description: Land Acquisition - Thammannakulama, Nuwaragampalatha East D/S Division, Anuradhapura District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific land parcels for public purposes, including descriptions of the lands, their locations, extents, and claimant information. The content focuses entirely on land-related administrative procedures without involving government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any other specialized categories.
